title: Data Scientist
job_description:
About The Role:
At Krom Bank Indonesia, we are building the future of digital banking through Machine Learning and AI, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agents. We are looking for a Data Scientist who will work closely with Analysts, Machine Learning Engineers, Product teams, and business stakeholders to build practical AI solutions that improve customer experience, internal operations, and business decision-making.
You will take ownership from problem discovery, experimentation, and model development to deployment and continuous improvement in production. Our ideal candidate is hands-on, result-focused, and strong in both quantitative thinking and business understanding.
⸻
Job Purpose:
Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered applications across functions such as credit scoring, fraud detection, risk management, customer intelligence, and operational automation.
⸻
Key Responsibilities:
Build and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered applications
Develop predictive models for credit scoring, fraud detection, recommendation systems, and customer segmentation
Build AI applications using LLMs, RAG, and AI agents for internal and customer-facing use cases
Design end-to-end AI pipelines from data preparation to production deployment
Research and improve models using modern ML techniques and AI tooling
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Risk, Operations, and Business teams to solve business problems
Monitor and improve model performance, reliability, and explainability
Contribute to Data Science and AI best practices across the team
About You:
Formal Education:
Minimum Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or other related quantitative fields.
⸻
Professional Qualification
Strong understanding of machine learning modeling and predictive analytics
Proficiency in Python or R
Good knowledge of MySQL/PostgreSQL and data platforms such as S3
Experience building and deploying ML or AI applications
Familiarity with LLMs and modern AI application patterns
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
Good communication and collaboration skills
Strong ownership mindset and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
⸻
Relevant Work Experience
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI development
Hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models or AI applications
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building LLM-powered applications such as chatbots, AI assistants, or AI agents
Familiarity with RAG, vector databases, and frameworks such as LangChain, Google ADK, or OpenAI Agents
Experience using FastAPI, Streamlit, or similar frameworks
Experience in Deep Learning and/or NLP models
Experience in fintech, digital banking, lending, or high-scale consumer platforms
Bonus Points
Experience with credit risk modeling, fraud detection, or alternate data evaluation in financial services

title: Machine Learning Engineer
job_description:
At Kredivo we are building the future of financial services that are fast, cheap and widely accessible, wrapped up in a beautiful UX. As we are growing bigger, we are looking for
Machine Learning Engineer
who will closely collaborate with Data Science team in feeding data (across functions such as, credit scoring, fraud, and risk) into financial models defined by data scientists. You will also be responsible to make sure that data science code is maintainable, scalable and debuggable.
Job Responsibility
Develop and implement ML pipeline infrastructure, including but not limited to: ETL (Extract, Transform and Load) of raw data into model features and building platform to automate ML training, testing and maintenance.
Partnering with Data Scientists to transform prototypes of predictive models into high performance, well integrated systems.
Qualifications
2-3 years of relevant experience in Data or Software Engineering and minimum 1-2 years hands-on experience in deploying machine learning models and feature pipelines
Having good knowledge of data structures, data modeling and software architecture related to Machine Learning
Ability to write robust production-ready code in Python & GoLang
High degree of proficiency with RDBMS (i.e. MySQL, PostgreSQL) and No-SQL platforms (i.e. S3)
Proficiency in machine learning libraries such as: Tensorflow/Keras, Pytorch, SparkML or MLeap
Strong interest in building scalable and reliable Machine Learning Engineering/AI related services
Past experience working with cloud services platform to build data pipelines, monitoring, scheduler and storage, preferably on AWS environment.
Familiarity using a distributed computing platform, such as Hadoop or Spark
Thank you for your interest in Kredivo. We’re thrilled that you’d like to join our company. Unfortunately, days are short and applicants are many, so we won’t have time to meet everyone. If you are among qualified candidates, you will receive a call or email from our Talent Acquisition team.
